info.name: SharpAI
info.description: SharpAI v4.0.1 requires Authorization: Bearer {{bearerToken}} for API requests. Use the private auth/default-bearer-token bootstrap file for model/inference access, or POST /v1.0/token with x-email, x-password and x-tenant-guid for an interactive session. Access keys and x-api-key are not accepted by the server. Credential administrators can reveal retained AES-GCM encrypted tokens or regenerate legacy hash-only credentials. Both actions are audited and return no-store responses; ordinary lists omit token values. See the Credential token management folder.

request.description: Pull organization/name or a validated Hugging Face HTTPS repository, tree revision, or resolve/blob GGUF URL. Exact revision and file selection are preserved. Only a final NDJSON status=success confirms publication; error records may occur after HTTP 200. Do not automatically retry ambiguous failures.

exec: pm.test("Pull publishes a verified model", () => { const frames = pm.response.text().split(/\r?\n/).filter(line => line.trim()).map(line => JSON.parse(line)); pm.expect(frames.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(frames.at(-1).status).to.equal("success"); pm.expect(frames.some(frame => frame.error)).to.equal(false); });

item.name: Authentication boundary
item.description: Read-only mandatory bearer checks. Set bearerToken in a private environment; telemetry must be enabled for the metrics check.

exec: pm.test('Anonymous API calls are challenged', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('Invalid bearer token is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('Bearer credential authorizes model reads', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Metrics cannot bypass the bearer boundary', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('Bearer credential authorizes metric scraping', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Credential token management
item.description: Requires Credential Admin permission in tenantGuid. Keep adminBearerToken in a private environment. Regeneration immediately invalidates the old token; execute only when intended. Legacy hash-only reveal returns 409; inactive/expired credentials remain inactive/expired after regeneration.

request.description: 200: {token,tokenType}; 401: missing/invalid bearer; 403: insufficient permission/tenant scope; 404: credential not in tenant; 409: legacy token not retained. Response is no-store; token is redacted from request history.

exec: pm.test('Secret responses must not be cached', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.eql('no-store'));

item.name: Regenerate credential bearer token (invalidates old token)

request.description: No body. Immediately invalidates the previous token; preserves credential ID, scopes, active flag and expiry. 200 replacement; 401 unauthenticated; 403 insufficient permission, wrong tenant or protected credential; 404 not found.

exec: pm.test('Secret responses must not be cached', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.eql('no-store'));

item.name: Terminal dashboard contracts
item.description: Read-only terminal-client contract checks. Supply a session bearer token with history/library access. No secrets are persisted by scripts.
